Final Year Project

Drug Availability &
Affordability Tracking

A location-aware pharmaceutical access platform

Built with .NET Core Vue.js Microsoft Azure OpenWeather API Agile Methodology
Problem Statement

Access to essential medicines remains a major challenge across developing regions, particularly in Africa. Patients struggle to identify which pharmacies have required drugs in stock or to compare prices across different locations.

This lack of visibility leads to delays in treatment, increased healthcare costs, and inefficient access to pharmaceutical services — disproportionately affecting communities with limited digital infrastructure.

Objective

To design and develop a Drug Availability and Affordability Tracking Platform that improves access to pharmaceutical services through a location-aware, user-centered approach.

The system enables users to search for medicines using commonly known drug names and retrieve results based on proximity, availability, and price across multiple pharmacies — without requiring user account creation.

Core Features
🔍

Smart Drug Search

Search by common drug name. Results sorted by price and proximity automatically.

📍

Geolocation Aware

Auto-detect or manually enter location. Distance-based pharmacy sorting included.

💰

Price Transparency

Compare drug prices across pharmacies. See availability status at a glance.

🛒

Cart & Checkout

Add items to cart, place orders, and checkout — no account required.

🗺️

Map Integration

View pharmacy locations on an interactive map. Open in Google Maps, Apple Maps or Waze.

🏪

Business Admin Panel

Pharmacies manage stock, orders, and transactions through a dedicated dashboard.

☁️

Cloud-Hosted

Deployed on Microsoft Azure for scalability, reliability, and global accessibility.

🚀

No Account Needed

Cart and search data saved locally. Zero friction for patients seeking medicine.

Methodology
1
Agile-Based Development

Iterative sprints for continuous refinement of features and user experience.

2
Backend — .NET Core

RESTful APIs powering drug search, pharmacy data, geolocation, and order management.

3
Frontend — Vue.js

Reactive, user-centered interface with real-time search results and cart management.

4
Cloud — Microsoft Azure

Database hosting, cloud storage, and deployment ensuring reliability at scale.

5
Testing — Functional & Non-functional

Prototype validated through both feature testing and performance/usability evaluation.

Key Results
✅

Effective improvement in the efficiency of locating medicines across multiple pharmacies simultaneously.

💡

Enhanced price transparency — users can compare KSh prices across pharmacies before purchasing.

📱

User-friendly interface validated through testing — no account required for drug search and ordering.

🌍

Demonstrated feasibility of location-aware digital health access without complex AI models.

🏥

Dual-sided platform — both patients and pharmacy administrators benefit from the system.

🔭
Conclusion & Future Work

pharmaNear demonstrates that a location-aware digital platform can significantly improve access to essential medicines without relying on complex AI models. The prototype validates the core hypothesis that proximity-aware search, price transparency, and e-commerce capabilities can reduce treatment delays in underserved regions.

Future directions include: real-time pharmacy inventory integration, expanded geographic coverage beyond Kenya, enhanced e-commerce capabilities (e.g., mobile money payments), and a dedicated mobile application for broader patient reach.
